channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Assam Civil Society files FIR against CM Sarma over alleged hate speech
item.description: The FIR accuses Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma of making hate-filled and provocative remarks against Bengali-origin Assamese Muslims

item.title: BJP names Tarun Chugh central observer for Manipur legislature party leader election
item.description: Two civil society organisations in Manipur have sought details from Home Ministry on the SoO agreement with Kuki-Zo militant groups

item.title: Erosion-control works under scanner in Saikhowa as forum alleges lapses
item.description: The Dibrugarh-Tinsukia District Flood and Erosion Resistance Struggle Forum alleged poor execution, delayed work, and irregularities

item.title: Mizoram records 3,354 new HIV cases in nine months, surge among 15–49 age group
item.description: Since 1990, Mizoram has recorded 33,878 HIV-positive cases, with 18,224 people currently receiving antiretroviral therapy

item.title: BJP’s real challenge in Goalpara (East) lies beyond minority math
item.description: Analysts argue that misreading the Goalpara (East) Assembly constituency as either unwinnable or transferable could carry long-term political costs ahead of the 2026 Assembly elections.

item.title: Manipur notifies three wetlands for first time under 2017 conservation rules
item.description: The Manipur government is implementing integrated management plans for five wetlands including Loktak Lake

item.title: BPF weighs contesting seats beyond BTR, signals fight for all 15 BTR constituencies
item.description: The Hagrama Mohilary-led BPF is asserting its claim over all 15 BTR constituencies, with seat-sharing talks with BJP likely after February 10.

item.title: Jamugurihat gears up to host 95th annual conference of Srimanta Sankardev Sangha
item.description: The conference will feature three days of naam-prasanga, cultural programmes, book releases, and participation from devotees across Assam and other states.

item.title: Over 2 lakh attend 21st Adivasi Mahasabha at Borgolai; rights & wages dominate discourse
item.description: The four-day witnessed Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren and Adivasi leaders raising issues of land rights, wage disparity, and political unity

item.title: Eviction drive clears 2,800 bighas of reserved forest land in Hailakandi
item.description: The eviction operation in Damcherra forest area impacted 516 families; drive involved over 1,500 security personnel and 150 bulldozers
